title: Football-field-sized vehicles moving through the ocean at 500 knots
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Football-field-sized vehicles moving through the ocean at 500 knots, about present at world's oceans, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: There are vehicles the size of a football field that are moving through the ocean at 500 knots.

plain: The podcast host Joe Rogan, speaking with host Jesse Michels, repeats a claim he credits to the US politician Marco Rubio in a documentary called The Age of Disclosure. According to Rogan, there are vehicles as big as a football field moving through the ocean at 500 knots, close to 600 miles an hour, which would be far beyond any known submarine.
